import time
import os
import glob

# Initialize AFM
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application

# Get access to different components
scan = application.Scan
opmode = application.OperatingMode
zcontrol = application.ZController
head = application.ScanHead

# Set operating mode to Dynamic AFM (tapping mode) to minimize tip damage
print("Setting operating mode to Dynamic AFM (tapping mode)...")
opmode.OperatingMode = spm.OperatingMode.DynamicAFM
opmode.VibratingAmpl = 1  # [V]

# Set scan parameters for 10x10 µm² with 128x128 resolution
print("Configuring scan parameters...")
scan.ImageWidth = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.ImageHeight = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.Points = 128  # points per line
scan.Lines = 128  # lines per frame

# Set filename prefix
file_name = "afm_scan_10um_"
application.SetGalleryHistoryFilenameMask(file_name)

print(f"Scan parameters set:")
print(f"  Image size: {scan.ImageWidth*1e6} x {scan.ImageHeight*1e6} µm²")
print(f"  Resolution: {scan.Points} x {scan.Lines}")
print(f"  Operating mode: Dynamic AFM")

# Get the current working directory to track where files are saved
workspace_dir = r'C:\Users\Admin\Desktop\corral\corral\tasks\afm\src\afm\claude-sonnet-4-5_subtasks_3_ReAct_work_1\enviroment\subtasks_3'
print(f"Workspace directory: {workspace_dir}")

# Start the scan
print("Starting scan...")
scan.StartFrameUp()

# Wait for scan to complete
scanning = scan.IsScanning
while scanning:
    remaining_lines = scan.Lines - scan.Currentline
    print(f"Scanning in progress... Remaining lines: {remaining_lines}")
    time.sleep(3)
    scanning = scan.IsScanning

print("Scanning finished!")

# Give a moment for file to be saved
time.sleep(2)

# Try to find the most recently created file in the workspace
print("Searching for saved image file...")

# Look for common AFM file extensions
file_patterns = ['*.nid', '*.spm', '*.nhf', '*.txt']
all_files = []
for pattern in file_patterns:
    search_path = os.path.join(workspace_dir, '**', pattern)
    files = glob.glob(search_path, recursive=True)
    all_files.extend(files)

if all_files:
    # Get the most recently modified file
    latest_file = max(all_files, key=os.path.getmtime)
    print(f"Found image file: {latest_file}")
    image_path = os.path.abspath(latest_file)
    print(f"Absolute path: {image_path}")
else:
    print("No image files found in workspace")
    image_path = None

# Clean up
del spm

print(f"\nFinal result: {image_path}")"}</action_input>
